create_shuffled_shard_list: create a ShuffledShardList dataset that yields deterministically shuffled shard URLs based on epoch
create_resampled_shards_v2: create a ResampledShardsV2 dataset that samples shard URLs with replacement and optional weights
iterate_shuffled_shards: iterate over a ShuffledShardList to get shuffled shard URLs for each epoch interval
iterate_resampled_shards: iterate over a ResampledShardsV2 to get randomly sampled shard URLs with optional weighting
review_shardlist_classes: review the ShuffledShardList and ResampledShardsV2 classes for PyTorch IterableDataset shard iteration patterns
